Psychology glossary

Randomised controlled trial

A study in which participants are randomly assigned to groups that do or do not receive an intervention, to compare outcomes. Randomisation makes the groups similar in everything else, so it is the best design for knowing whether a treatment causes an effect.

Related terms

  • Correlation
  • Meta-analysis
  • Placebo effect
